program='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Connected components of the colored rays.
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (1,8)}
    segments=[]
    while pts:
        seed=pts.pop(); comp={seed}; stack=[seed]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in pts:
                    pts.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        segments.append(comp)
    ones={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==1}
    pluses=[]
    while ones:
        seed=ones.pop(); comp={seed}; stack=[seed]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in ones:
                    ones.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        pluses.append(comp)
    for seg in segments:
        rs=[p[0] for p in seg]; cs=[p[1] for p in seg]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        vertical=(r1-r0)>=(c1-c0)
        best=None
        for p in pluses:
            prs=[q[0] for q in p]; pcs=[q[1] for q in p]
            pr0,pr1,pc0,pc1=min(prs),max(prs),min(pcs),max(pcs)
            if vertical and not (pc1<c0 or pc0>c1):
                if pr1<r0: cand=(r0-pr1,'down')
                elif pr0>r1: cand=(pr0-r1,'up')
                else: continue
            elif not vertical and not (pr1<r0 or pr0>r1):
                if pc1<c0: cand=(c0-pc1,'right')
                elif pc0>c1: cand=(pc0-c1,'left')
                else: continue
            else: continue
            if best is None or cand[0]<best[0]: best=cand
        if best is None: continue
        direction=best[1]
        if vertical:
            rows=range(r0-1,-1,-1) if direction=='up' else range(r1+1,h)
            for r in rows:
                source=r0+(r-r0)%2
                for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                    if g[r][c]==8: g[r][c]=g[source][c]
        else:
            cols=range(c0-1,-1,-1) if direction=='left' else range(c1+1,w)
            for c in cols:
                source=c0+(c-c0)%2
                for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                    if g[r][c]==8: g[r][c]=g[r][source]
    return g
'''
